fields.title: agent: subagents fail auth despite main provider working
fields.description: Spawning smart/deep can fail before execution with provider auth errors (moonshot/kimi-for-coding: missing apiKey/authToken; openai-codex/gpt-5.5: No API key) even though the main pi command can use moonshot/kimi-for-coding successfully. Root cause likely in tau agent model/auth resolution or worker session construction using configured agent model defaults instead of current session/provider auth. Also pi CLI reports stale extension ctx errors after a one-shot prompt, likely from a tau event handler retaining old ctx. Need reproduce from code/tests, fix agent path, add regression, run extensions/tau gate.
